Page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.127.html. Spike: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/grok/spike/report.md, spike_targets.diff (applies clean on develop c5d876649). Experiments: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/x/a/report.md (gates, 180 generated programs, row budget), /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/x/t/report.md (tower counterfactuals), /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/x/mu/report.md (September recursive-type branch).

Defect. Two Enum.reduce sites over [1, 2, 3], both seeded [], one lambda doing h + e on the head and one consing {e, 6}: elixir prints {[6, 3, 1], [{3, 6}, {2, 6}, {1, 6}]}, fz reports spec/violation +/2 ({int, int}, int). Either site alone compiles. Repro /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/grok/err.fz. The same defect rejects the hand-written wrapper /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/k127/p2/w.fz with +/2 (%{}, int).

Cause. Semantic analysis records, per call site, exact targets: a named closure with the argument types it is called at. Runtime demand answers the same question again with bare surfaces: closure_callee_demand (jobs/runtime_demand.rs) writes every target's surface into CallableDemand.resolved, callers' answers are unioned, record_first_class_demand hands the union to every construction the value flowed from, and plan_callable_flows requests one construction target per (construction, surface). The pairings no analysis claimed are minted by SeedActivation and then analysed; one fails to type. With n sites sharing a seed type the wrapper lambda gets n(n+1) keys where 2n are called (6/20/72 at n = 2/4/8).

Rule. A surface that belongs to a named target travels through runtime demand only as that target. CallableDemand.resolved holds only surfaces no target names.

Change. closure_callee_demand records a target with an activation only in targets; resolved gets a surface only when some target has no activation or there are no targets. A construction's first-class surfaces are resolved plus the surfaces of the first-class targets that name it (callable_flow_edges_for_targets: same function, same capture types), added before ground_dispatch_surfaces; direct_surfaces includes the direct edges' surfaces. record_first_class_boundary_demand keeps targets. CallableDemand::surfaces() (resolved plus each target's surface) is read at the two generic-owner positions in jobs/transport.rs. The spike's record_first_class_targets_for_value duplicates record_direct_targets_for_value's walk; the build folds them into one.

Measured (base 7faa29377 -> spike): err.fz rejected -> elixir's output on interp and run; same-seed n = 2/4/8 wrapper keys 6/20/72 -> 4/8/16, SeedActivation 2/12/56 -> 0; two.fz keys 309 -> 267; w.fz rejected -> compiles; five OptionParser probes identical keys and jobs; instructions -3.1% typed.fz, -10.3% two.fz; 180 generated programs all match elixir (base rejects 22); workspace all-targets fails only the three below; doc tests and clippy clean; distiller highest request id 63,457 -> 53,684.

Pins that fall: drive_test compiler2_a_stream_over_any_enumerable_keeps_its_activations_finite, Stream.compose/2#lambda@0/2 8 -> 7 and whole-program 145 -> 140. Two transport_contract_test tests read callable.resolved and move to surfaces().

Not in this ticket. The distiller's 50,000 request budget (53,684 after this change) is fz-sc8.146. The closure tower cut (fold_self_nested_closures) stays: with this change it gives no wrong result in anything measured, accounts for no distiller activation, and the keep-the-leaf counterfactual changes only w.fz and w2.fz.

Open observation: once nine or more sites share a seed type the row budget collapses the forwarder's rows and the wrapper lambda has nine keys more than the hand count (27 against 18 at n = 9); outputs are right. Unexplained.

Acceptance: fixtures 01134 (err.fz) and 01135 (w.fz) match elixir on interp, JIT and AOT; a telemetry test pins zero SeedActivation jobs on the two-site program and 16 wrapper keys at eight same-seed sites; keys and jobs unchanged on the five OptionParser probes; full gate green; fact-engine.md states the rule; fixtures.md row updated.
title: A closure is compiled for the arguments its call sites name, not for every shape that passed the same forwarder
